title: Damping, forced oscillations and resonance; Energy in SHM
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for AP Physics C: Mechanics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: O04-1#t3 term and clue written for the game; O03-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; O03-1#t3 term and clue written for the game; O04-1#t2 term and clue written for the game. Questions: O03-1#N.1b, O04-1#N.2b, O03-1#N.9b, O04-1#N.10a.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Forced oscillation
items.clue: Motion kept going by a periodic driver, which sets its steady rate.

items.label: Turning point
items.clue: Either extreme, x = +A or x = –A, where the oscillator is momentarily at rest.

items.label: Total energy
items.clue: Sum that stays constant for an undamped oscillator: a horizontal line against x.

items.label: Natural frequency
items.clue: Symbol f₀: cycles per second of a system that is displaced, let go and left alone.

questions.stem: A block attached to a horizontal ideal spring oscillates on a surface with negligible friction. At an instant when the block's kinetic energy has its minimum value, which of the following is true of the spring potential energy U_s of the block–spring system?

options.text: It is zero, because the block is momentarily at rest.
It has its maximum value, equal to the system's total energy.
It has its minimum value, as the system then has the least energy.
It has the same value as at every other instant of the motion.

questions.stem: A 0.10 kg block on a horizontal frictionless surface is attached to an ideal spring of spring constant 1000 N/m. A sinusoidal force drives the block at 0.50 Hz for some time; then the driving force is removed while the block is displaced from equilibrium. Damping is negligible. At what frequency does the block oscillate after the driving force is removed?

A block of mass m attached to an ideal spring of spring constant k oscillates with amplitude A on a horizontal surface with negligible friction. Which expression gives the speed of the block when it is at x = A/2, halfway between the equilibrium position and a turning point?
A singer shatters a wine glass by singing one steady note close to it. Which condition is essential for this to happen?

options.text: The note is very loud, whatever frequency the singer chooses.
The note is the highest frequency that the singer is able to produce.
The note's frequency is equal to a natural frequency of the glass.
The sound echoes inside the bowl of the glass and builds up.
